correctness.rationale: Inspected actual RESULT.md and verify.py at Git tree a5d6c668c36a862449589f19075b9818f471d78d. A vertex outside D in part i has exactly d-d_i selected neighbors. Hence a proper fair dominating set is equivalent to equality d_i=t over every non-full part and positive d-t. For t=0,...,L-1 each part of size <=t must be full, other parts choose full or exactly t of n_i; disjoint classification except V(G) repeated L times and empty D once. Thus D_f=ΣP_t-(L-1)x^N-1. For minimal size t=0 implies one whole part (at least min n_i), t>=1 implies all r parts selected, yielding min(r,min n_i). Independently enumerated all vertex subsets for 58 nondecreasing multipartite profiles of N<=8 and matched every polynomial coefficient and minimum; unrestricted proof is symbolic.
